description: Live run-tool E2E tool list for the PhantomCamera Tools extension (Class B — wraps the third-party Phantom Camera addon). Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py from the e2e-godot CI leg against a connected headless editor (with the pinned Phantom Camera addon installed into testbed/addons/phantom_camera and its PhantomCameraManager autoload registered) + a local gamedev-mcp-server. Each entry is one real assertion: a regression in the tool turns the CI leg red.
notes: phantomcamera-defaults is pure-managed (no scene, no addon needed). The editor tools resolve nodes relative to the edited scene root, so 'setup' opens a scene via the core scene-create tool. host-create creates a Camera3D named 'Camera3D' under Root and a PhantomCameraHost under it; create makes 'PCam'; set-follow/set-look-at target that Camera3D. Each happy-path editor entry asserts "Installed":true (the Class-B presence gate is satisfied because the addon is installed). 'expect' substrings are matched against godot-cli's compact --raw JSON (ReflectorNet serializes the PascalCase property names of PhantomCameraInfo).
